title: Customizable homepage carousel
subtitle: Design + front-end build · Enterprise marketing site
problem: Marketing needed to customize homepage carousel slides by target audience without engineering involvement each time.

constraints.title: Multi-region
constraints.desc: Content needed translation support across regions

constraints.title: Third-party A/B testing
constraints.desc: Component had to integrate with an external test platform

approach: Built a slide component with configurable audience targeting, structured so copy and imagery stayed swappable per locale and per A/B variant served by the third-party platform.
result: Delivered a customizable widget, built on the third-party platform, where a marketer's custom slide overrides the existing homepage carousel.
reflection: Once marketing had the tool in hand, they ran with it — using the flexibility to create compelling, creative slides beyond what I'd initially anticipated.

title: Responsive end-equipment reference diagram
subtitle: Design + front-end build · Enterprise marketing site
problem: End-equipment diagram and related product information display was unorganized.

constraints.title: Limited viewport
constraints.desc: Especially constrained on laptop, tablet, and mobile devices

constraints.title: Dense reference content
constraints.desc: Diagram and related product listings needed to coexist on screen

approach: Built a responsive display to adapt the diagram and related product panel layout to different screen sizes.
result: Display had a better flow, making it easier for customers to find related products and reference designs.
reflection: Engineers submitting diagrams found it easier to design them based on how they'd actually display on the web page.
